title.narrative: Emergency Livelihood assistance to floods-affected households in Kosovo

description.narrative: This project represents an immediate response to the flooding affecting mostly North Kosovo municipalities. From the 19th to 23rd of January floods caused by heavy rainfalls and the lack of proper river maintenance and supporting riverbanks triggered the river of Ibar to overflow and damage many houses and households, including agricultural, public, and private property. In total 11 municipalities were affected out of which four Municipalities of Leposavic, Zubin Potok, Srbica/Skenderaj, and Mitrovica South had the most damage caused by the floods. This caused temporary displacement of people and left their homes unprotected and affected by the floods, causing most of their furniture and appliances to be damaged or completely ruined. The main objective of the project is to address the needs of households for emergency relief in the form of goods (appliances and furniture) and services (small-scale reparation works). The project will also include activities on the assessment of damage for each household, identification of specific needs, and provision of long-term development instructions and directions in the form of a workshop where all stakeholders will address the issue of future disaster risks.
